travelAdvisory.summary:
Exercise normal precautionin Malaysia. Some areas have increased risk. Read the entire Travel Advisory.
Malaysia is generally a safe destination for travelers.
Exercise increased caution on islands and maritime areas off the coast of Eastern Sabah from Kudat in the north to Tawau in the south due to risk of kidnapping.

connectivity.simOptions: Hotlink (Maxis), Celcom, or Digi at KLIA or 7-Eleven. RM30-50 for tourist plans.
connectivity.wifiAvailability: Good WiFi at malls, hotels, cafes. Spotty in Borneo jungle.

cultural.tipping: Not expected. Some upscale restaurants add 10% service charge.
cultural.dressCode: Modest at mosques (robes provided). Remove shoes at mosques and homes.
cultural.greetings: Light handshake then touch heart. Don't offer handshake to opposite gender unless initiated.
cultural.haggling: Expected at night markets. Not at malls or supermarkets.

practical.visaFreeCountries: US citizens: 90 days visa-free. Very easy entry.
practical.bestTimeToVisit: March-October for west coast. November-February for east coast. KL hot year-round.
